title: The Nine identified as a UFO in low Earth orbit, later contacted by Uri Geller
summary: Peter Levenda tells of The Nine identified as a UFO in low Earth orbit, later contacted by Uri Geller, about 1950s-1970s at low Earth orbit, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> which later become identified as residents of a UFO in low earth orbit. >> The same one that is later then being contacted by Uri Geller,

plain: A writer, Peter Levenda, says that The Nine, a group of beings first contacted through seances in the 1950s, were later described as living on a UFO in low Earth orbit. He says this was the same craft later contacted by Uri Geller, a performer known for claimed psychic powers, with the researcher Andrija Puharich linking the two. If true, it would tie decades of contact claims to a single source in the sky.
